sources.story_title: News trigger + Layer 2: second-phase submarine cable landing license rules effective July 8, 2026 (foreign-carrier-affiliation approval, security certification, circuit-capacity reporting; 47 CFR 1.70009, 1.70024, 43.82)

Layer 1 statutory delegation (Submarine Cable Landing License Act of 1921, 47 U.S.C. 34-39; EO 10530) + Layer 4 chokepoint: referrals to State and the Committee for the Assessment of Foreign Participation (Quintillion SCL-MOD-20250930-00070 referred Feb 17 2026; GCI Liberty transfer-of-control referred Mar 20 2026)

Layer 3: foreign-adversary substantive presumption against granting a landing license to entities owned/controlled/directed by a foreign adversary; Committee composition (AG chair, with Defense and Homeland Security)
